paragraphs: Rabbi Yochanan bar Ravina: HaMatznia; see there, 94b, ‘Rabbi Yochanan, brother of Mar son of Ravina.’ In Rif the reading is ‘Rav Acha son of Rav.’ He spoke to Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak.
